meta.name: fix
meta.description: Debug and fix bugs/errors/failures, including merge conflicts and failing PR CI checks. Triggers "fix", "broken", "not working", "bug", "error", "failing", "merge conflict", "fix CI", "checks failing", console errors, build/test failures, regression.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动定位并修复代码中的各类错误
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到代码错误、构建失败或合并冲突需要快速修复
copy.tagline_en: Automatically locate and fix various errors in your code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently encounter code errors, build failures, or merge conflicts that need quick fixing

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动执行一个调试修复工作流：先探索代码、重现错误、诊断根因，再实现修复、验证，并记录经验。它只修改与 bug 直接相关的文件，每次修复后都会运行构建测试。
howto.when: 当你提到“fix”、“broken”、“bug”等关键词，或遇到合并冲突、PR CI 检查失败时，Claude 会自动触发修复流程。

say.text: 修复这个bug：用户登录后页面崩溃。
say.note: Claude 会开始探索并修复。
Claude 会检测冲突并自动解决。
Claude 会检查CI日志并修复。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude executes an automated debug-fix workflow: explore code, reproduce bug, diagnose root cause, implement fix, verify, and store learnings. It modifies only bug-related files and runs builds after each fix.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "fix", "broken", "bug", or encounter merge conflicts, failing PR CI checks, etc.

say_en.text: Fix this bug: user login crashes the page.

say_en.note: Claude inspects CI logs and applies fixes.
